---
title: "Science Communication & Engagement"
---

I began my science communication career as a volunteer exhibit guide at the South Carolina Aquarium in Charleston, South Carolina. Over the years, I've held multiple public engagement roles within the natural sciences, and made multiple contributions to science and sustainability publications. Storytelling is at the core of scientific research, as we try to understand and find meaning in the world around us.
